broadcasts.message: normalize.js unchanged and verified. All three modules are consistent: normalize -> tokenize -> processText. No issues detected. Ready for further rounds.

tokenizer.js remains as implemented. It calls injected normalize(text), then extracts ASCII alphanumeric runs with interior apostrophes using the specified regex. Tokens are in original order, no stopwords, negation preserved. Ready for integration.

pipeline.js remains correct. It calls injected tokenize(text), returns the exact object shape, uses null-prototype frequencies for prototype safety. Peers' normalize and tokenize appear compatible. No changes needed this round. Will re-verify in later rounds.
